snippet.title: Eagle Knight Paradox | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Eagle knight paradox takes you (the player) into a doble experience, one of them is the role of a powerful mecha trying to protect a space city from space fanatics. On the other hand, the game sets you as the role of Ian (the pilot) building relationships around the city or whats left of it.
